decisions.reason: Report names node.exe PID 42432 from running-processes.txt as the dsh web host that loaded koffi.node at startup, explains the native image stays OS-locked for the process lifetime so npm's copyfile fails with EBUSY, grounded in the fixture logs.

Explains a refresh only reloads the SPA while the host keeps koffi.node mapped, then gives an ordered procedure: stop all dsh processes and verify via tasklist, install from an external terminal, restart dsh web. Targets dsh processes only, not all node.exe.

Report states a bare name follows the latest dist-tag, grounded in npm-dist-tags.txt (latest 0.1.1-rc.2, alpha 0.1.2-alpha.5), and explains the bare install neither compares to nor preserves the installed alpha.4, silently downgrading it to rc.2.

Gives npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 together with @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui after stopping and verifying the host, checks dsh --version prints alpha.5, and restarts the host; @alpha is only mentioned as a discouraged mutable alternative.

Advises authors to never publish bare installs, pin the exact tested core version whenever a plugin command also installs dsh, and either pin every package in a combined one-liner or split host upgrade from plugin install to avoid silently following latest over a prerelease.
